title: An accurate correction leaves requests room

captions.physics: Revealing an absolute reproach’s unsound basis
captions.emotions: Feeling proportion between words and attention

meaning: You can reveal an absolute reproach’s unsound basis and speak with friendly interest, feeling the difference between inaccurate phrasing and a real request to be heard.
text: The Tower in the physical position of your Vishuddha reveals an absolute reproach’s unsound basis. The Sun in energy supports open, friendly interest in what is said and a wish to clarify the question directly. Justice in emotions brings a sense of proportion between words and actual participation. You can see an emphatic formula’s inaccuracy without losing sight of the need to talk behind it. Clarity concerns both the fact and what was nevertheless missing from the recent exchange.

For example, “We never talk about my impressions” meets a reminder of yesterday’s brief conversation. The absolute statement loses its foundation. **A corrected reproach may still contain an important request**. You can name what was heard yesterday and what remained beyond a quick answer. Friendliness helps continue the subject without competing over memories. A fair sense of proportion emerges: the conversation is recognised, but its existence does not require treating every missing response as imaginary.

Difficulty arises if the discovered fact becomes a final answer to wanting greater attention. An accurate correction turns conversation into counting remarks while the request remains unheard. Constructive Sun energy helps preserve open participation after an inaccurate phrase has been disproved. You can acknowledge that “never” does not fit events and seriously discuss today’s request; proportion requires neither accepting exaggeration nor reducing a need to yesterday’s number of questions.
